argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $u='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats?inspect=1'; $res=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12; if($null -eq $res.chats){Write-Output 'MISSING_CHATS_ARRAY';exit 3}; $a=@($res.chats); Write-Output ('INSPECTED_CHAT_COUNT='+$a.Count); Write-Output ('INSPECTED_TRUE='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.inspected -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('IDLE='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.status -eq 'idle'}).Count); Write-Output ('ONE_TAB='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.openTabs -eq 1}).Count); Write-Output ('HIGH_MODE='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.highMode -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('ORIGINAL_STICKY='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.stickyPinned -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('CONTEXT_LIMIT='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.contextLimit -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('GENERATING='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.generating -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('DRAFT_PRESENT='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.draftPresent -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('PROVIDER_LOAD_ERROR='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.providerLoadError -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('RATE_LIMITED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.providerRateLimited -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENT='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.activeAssignmentCount -gt 0}).Count); Write-Output ('BROWSER_TARGET_PINNED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.targetId -or $_.cdpTargetId}).Count); Write-Output ('SCHEMA_KEYS='+ ((@($a)|Select-Object -First 1|Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty|Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name|Where-Object {$_ -in @('status','inspected','openTabs','highMode','stickyPinned','documentEpoch','contextLimit','providerLoadError','providerRateLimited')}) -join ','))

note: Read-only source-managed CDP inspection via existing Bridge API, print ONLY counts of safety fields, no chat identities, Chrome navigation, sends or screenshots
